title: QUIZ - 30
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a numerical expression written in exponential form
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 4^2 \)
questions.explanation: \( 4^2 \) means multiplying 4 by itself 2 times: \(4 \times 4 = 16\).
questions.hint: An exponent tells you how many times to multiply the base by itself; it is not the same as multiplying base by exponent.

questions.concept: Comparing Powers with the Same Base
questions.learningObjective: Compare two powers that share the same base by reasoning about the exponents
questions.question: Which is greater: \( 6^3 \) or \( 6^2 \)?
questions.explanation: \( 6^3 \) = 216 and \( 6^2 \) = 36. Since the base is greater than 1, the power with the larger exponent (3) is greater.
questions.hint: For a base greater than 1, a larger exponent produces a larger value.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a numerical expression written in exponential form
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 4^4 \)
questions.explanation: \( 4^4 \) means multiplying 4 by itself 4 times: \(4 \times 4 \times 4 \times 4 = 256\).
questions.hint: An exponent tells you how many times to multiply the base by itself; it is not the same as multiplying base by exponent.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the exponent in a given power expression
questions.question: In the expression \( 2^2 \), what is the exponent?
questions.explanation: In \( 2^2 \), 2 is the base and 2 is the exponent, indicating how many times the base is used as a factor.
questions.hint: The exponent is the small raised number that indicates repeated multiplication.
